title: storage: add auto-save hook
description: Implement an auto-save mechanism that automatically persists transcript state at configurable intervals and key events. This ensures minimal data loss during unexpected terminations and provides seamless persistence without requiring explicit save calls from the user.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL integrate auto-save hook with the transcript state management
THE SYSTEM SHALL make auto-save configurable with custom intervals and triggers

event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL automatically persist the current transcript state to storage

event_driven.trigger: WHEN a significant state change occurs
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL schedule an auto-save operation if debouncing allows

unwanted.condition: IF auto-save operations are triggered too frequently
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT degrade performance with excessive I/O
unwanted.because: user experience must remain responsive during active use

unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT block or crash the application
unwanted.because: graceful degradation is preferred over total failure

preconditions: State change notifications must be observable
Auto-save configuration must be loaded or use defaults
postconditions: Transcript state is automatically persisted at configured intervals
Failed auto-save operations are logged and retried
Auto-save can be paused and resumed programmatically
invariants: Auto-save never saves more frequently than the minimum interval
Pending auto-save operations complete before shutdown
Auto-save state does not affect transcript content

happy: Verify auto-save triggers after the configured interval
Verify auto-save captures the latest transcript state
Verify auto-save can be enabled and disabled at runtime
Verify debouncing prevents excessive saves during rapid updates
error: Verify auto-save handles storage failures gracefully without blocking
Verify auto-save retries after transient failures
Verify auto-save state is preserved if interrupted mid-save

phase_2: Create AutoSaveHook struct with interval and debounce config

similar: See debounce patterns in existing codebase
